implementation: MemberConnectedSetup constructs existing installation, remote setup and execution ports only after original control creation identity is persisted and actual readback resolves its endpoint.

The exact endpoint, control pin, SSH key hashes, TLS/settings/import material and scope are bound in the host journal before any upload; resumed cleanup uses the sealed address without a new creation permission or provider discovery.

Construction has no network effects. Unknown prior effects, lost binding, changed material, stopped/expired stages and rollback fail closed; local-only empty cleanup requires absence of every known remote dispatch marker.

Repeated stopped cleanup can reuse confirmed snapshots after controller deletion without new SSH. OS package readiness, approved host keys and TLS material are explicit prerequisites, not acquired by this class.

verified: Actual outer driver, disk journal and exclusive lock own all ten initialization stages, actual native retry and controller-last cleanup.
Setup constructs no placeholder SSH host. The endpoint comes from the exact control provider readback, with strict existing SSH verification and immutable key/material binding.
Full application and locked vendor, real MySQL/Redis, 160 migrations, 157 tables, UID65534, systemd/nginx/PHP and self-signed TLS run in the disconnected Linux fixture.
Source A/B each register three fresh synthetic HTTP/TLS reports. Source creation gap is 301 real seconds.

A1 retains three complete failures and exactly one deletion; two absence reads are thirteen seconds apart. A2 dispatch follows confirmed cleanup by 302 real seconds, exceeding the unchanged 300-second cooldown.
One edge-a DNS update occurs; B task, identity and DNS remain unchanged.

Three owned DNS records and six private files are removed before controller deletion. Independent cleanup deletes the control fixture once and confirms absence twice ten seconds apart without further SSH.
Outer journal is closed, first error and pending request are null, resources_cleaned and isolated acceptance are true, closed replay is a no-op.
Stopped application evidence is locally read back and its content hash independently verified. Dedicated containers and fixture are removed; no external routes.

prior_failed_attempt.reason: CI switched only one transport.execute object from the installation fixture to the full-app fixture. Concrete deferred assembly reconstructed later transports from the original callback, resulting in fixture_setup_scope at source advance.
prior_failed_attempt.fix: The CI helper propagates its changed byte-boundary callback to the deferred setup factory. Production checks and scope validation were not relaxed.

limitations: Provider HTTP, SSH and DNS side effects remain simulated. No real cloud, production credential bridge, production database or live DNS was accessed.
Node ELF and agent/Ping payloads are synthetic and the binary is not executed; this does not establish real installation, WAN reachability or live cutover.
The additive run_connected_round entry at a8b14576 was not part of this full run; its separate lock/constructor regressions must not be reported as another whole-app pass.
Legacy helper-local markers remain in original artifacts. Final native teardown is owned and proved by the outer host, not the earlier retry-only helper.
The temporary workflow and CI-specific scripts are not main-branch changes.
